entries.title: Market analysis: Norwegian grocery retail
entries.text: Three groups sell almost all groceries in Norway and low-price chains keep growing. The change to watch is the government’s plan to open the big groups’ wholesale systems to small challengers. The first in a weekly series with competitor analysis, PESTEL and SWOT.
entries.tools: Market analysis, competitor analysis, PESTEL, SWOT

entries.title: CV generator
entries.text: Write a CV once and download a clean one-page version as a Word file or PDF, with a live preview, a check that it fits on one page, and English or Norwegian headings.

entries.title: What does Gjensidige’s share price assume?
entries.text: A justified price-to-book valuation that works backwards from the share price to the return on equity the market is pricing in.

entries.title: Who makes money on insurance itself?
entries.text: Combined ratios for Gjensidige, Tryg and Sampo since 2023, and what drives the differences between them.

entries.title: Simulating a year of claims
entries.text: A Monte Carlo simulation of an insurer’s annual claims that shows how often premiums fall short and how much capital the worst year in 200 requires. Also written in Python.
entries.tools: Monte Carlo simulation, Solvency II, JavaScript, Python

entries.title: Portfolio and CAPM calculator
entries.text: An interactive efficient frontier for two assets, the best risk-adjusted mix and the required return on equity.

entries.title: Case: student contents insurance
entries.text: A consulting-style case that sizes the market for contents insurance among students in Norway, tests the assumptions and recommends how an insurer should approach the segment.

entries.title: Careless or grossly careless?
entries.text: How Norwegian insurance law separates ordinary carelessness from gross negligence, explained through two cases from the complaints board.

entries.title: What does it cost to wait?
entries.text: A conceptual study of how to prioritise tasks. The result is an index that ranks tasks by cost of delay per calibrated hour, with urgency calculated from the slack to each deadline, plus a check that shows overload before it becomes a crisis. Built as a calculator too.
entries.tools: Scheduling theory, decision analysis, behavioural economics, JavaScript

entries.title: Market concentration calculator
entries.text: Calculates the Herfindahl–Hirschman Index for any market and shows what a merger would do to concentration. Comes loaded with the Norwegian non-life insurance market.

entries.title: Young adults and insurance loyalty
entries.text: Group project in Methods and Insight at BI: a market study of what drives loyalty among 18–29-year-olds in Norway, with If P&C Insurance as the case. Three focus groups, 187 survey respondents and four customer segments from cluster analysis.
entries.tools: JMP, focus groups, cluster analysis, ANOVA, regression
